# WorktreeProof

> Vibe fast. Ship with proof.

## Summary

WorktreeProof is open-source vibe coding guardrails for AI coding agents. It is a local-first JavaScript and Node.js toolkit for naming a bounded lane, reserving a non-overlapping scope, running focused checks, and recording a redacted closure receipt.

## What is included

- Plain Agent Skills for portable scope-and-proof habits.
- Safe delegation patterns with unique lane identities and explicit ownership.
- Worktree and reservation helpers for isolated parallel changes.
- Capability-aware tool selection and focused recipes.
- UI review notes alongside keyboard and responsive checks.
- Best-practice guidance for bounded context and resource-aware runs.
- Closure receipts that keep commands, checks, evidence, and disposition inspectable.

## Facts

- Repository: https://github.com/Nedal7707/worktree-proof
- Landing page: https://nedal7707.github.io/worktree-proof/
- License: Apache-2.0
- Version shown on this page: 0.1.0
- Runtime: Node.js 20 or newer
- Runtime dependencies: none

## Privacy and limits

The toolkit keeps state in the project where it runs and has no built-in telemetry by default. Read the source before enabling integrations. WorktreeProof does not replace human review, release ownership, or a security process, and it makes no claims about adoption, popularity, or guaranteed outcomes.

## Contribution

Read the repository contributing notes, try a focused recipe, and propose a small, inspectable change.
